articles.summary: Lunai Bioworks Inc. (Nasdaq: LNAI) (the "Company") announced that on October 21, 2026, it received a letter from the Listing Qualifications Department of The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC ("Nasdaq") stating that the Company no longer complies with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(b)(1), which requires minimum stockholders' equity of $2,500,000. The Company reported a stockholders' deficit of $(9,024,946) in its Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026, and does not meet the alternative market value of listed securities or net income standards. Because the Company is subject to a mandatory Hearings Panel Monitor under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5815(d)(4)(B), Nasdaq staff determined to delist the Company's securities. Trading in the Company's common stock on Nasdaq is expected to be suspended at the opening of business on October 30, 2026. The Company will not request a hearing. Rather than contest the staff determination, the Company's Board of Directors approved on October 22,
articles.title: Lunai Bioworks Announces Receipt of Nasdaq Determination and Intention to Voluntarily Delist and Deregister
